Render a dark, atmospheric hero scene featuring a single, steaming bowl of vegan ramen as the sole visual focus. Make the dish feel alive and appetizing — with natural motion, ambient warmth, and interactive response to the mouse. Keep the scene pure (no UI, text, or menus), responsive on all screens, and respectful of prefers-reduced-motion.
I’ll inspect the workspace, then build the scene as a self-contained canvas/CSS composition with responsive sizing, subtle pointer parallax, and a reduced-motion mode.

+  <title>Steaming Vegan Ramen</title>
+  <style>
+    :root {
+      color-scheme: dark;
+      --scene-x: 0px;
+      --scene-y: 0px;
+      --tilt-x: 0deg;
+      --tilt-y: 0deg;
+      --steam-x: 0px;
+      --steam-y: 0px;
+      --steam-skew: 0deg;
+      --glow-x: 50%;
+      --glow-y: 56%;
+    }
+
+    * {
+      box-sizing: border-box;
+    }
+
+    html,
+    body {
+      width: 100%;
+      min-height: 100%;
+      margin: 0;
+      overflow: hidden;
+      background: #030504;
+    }
+
+    body {
+      min-height: 100vh;
+      min-height: 100svh;
+      font-family: system-ui, sans-serif;
+    }
+
+    .scene {
+      position: relative;
+      isolation: isolate;
+      width: 100vw;
+      height: 100vh;
+      height: 100svh;
+      overflow: hidden;
+      background:
+        radial-gradient(ellipse at var(--glow-x) var(--glow-y), rgba(177, 73, 24, .15) 0%, rgba(98, 43, 20, .07) 23%, transparent 48%),
+        radial-gradient(ellipse at 50% 31%, #17201a 0%, #0a0f0c 38%, #050806 66%, #020302 100%);
+    }
+
+    .scene::before {
+      position: absolute;
+      z-index: -3;
+      top: -28%;
+      left: 50%;
+      width: min(78vw, 920px);
+      height: 112%;
+      content: "";
+      transform: translateX(-50%) perspective(700px) rotateX(-12deg);
+      transform-origin: 50% 0;
+      border-radius: 50%;
+      background: linear-gradient(180deg, rgba(180, 201, 168, .07), rgba(143, 94, 49, .025) 42%, transparent 78%);
+      filter: blur(28px);
+      opacity: .8;
+    }
+
+    .scene::after {
+      position: absolute;
+      z-index: 10;
+      inset: 0;
+      pointer-events: none;
+      content: "";
+      background:
+        radial-gradient(ellipse at 50% 53%, transparent 27%, rgba(0, 0, 0, .15) 62%, rgba(0, 0, 0, .72) 112%),
+        linear-gradient(180deg, rgba(0, 0, 0, .2), transparent 35%, rgba(0, 0, 0, .24));
+    }
+
+    .ambient-glow {
+      position: absolute;
+      z-index: -2;
+      top: calc(var(--glow-y) - 28%);
+      left: var(--glow-x);
+      width: clamp(320px, 42vw, 680px);
+      aspect-ratio: 1;
+      transform: translate(-50%, -50%);
+      border-radius: 50%;
+      background: radial-gradient(circle, rgba(231, 116, 46, .12), rgba(170, 62, 20, .035) 45%, transparent 70%);
+      filter: blur(22px);
+      animation: ambient-breathe 7s ease-in-out infinite alternate;
+      pointer-events: none;
+    }
+
+    .table {
+      position: absolute;
+      z-index: -1;
+      right: -12%;
+      bottom: -20%;
+      left: -12%;
+      height: 58%;
+      transform: perspective(760px) rotateX(57deg);
+      transform-origin: 50% 0;
+      border-top: 1px solid rgba(155, 130, 99, .06);
+      background:
+        radial-gradient(ellipse at 50% 9%, rgba(106, 48, 22, .1), transparent 44%),
+        linear-gradient(180deg, rgba(19, 23, 19, .9), #070907 52%, #030403 100%);
+      box-shadow: inset 0 24px 70px rgba(0, 0, 0, .45);
+    }
+
+    .art {
+      position: absolute;
+      z-index: 1;
+      top: 50%;
+      left: 50%;
+      width: clamp(520px, min(112vw, 133vh), 1240px);
+      height: auto;
+      overflow: visible;
+      transform:
+        translate(-50%, -50%)
+        translate3d(var(--scene-x), var(--scene-y), 0)
+        perspective(1100px)
+        rotateX(var(--tilt-x))
+        rotateY(var(--tilt-y));
+      transform-origin: 50% 67%;
+      will-change: transform;
+    }
+
+    .floor-shadow {
+      animation: shadow-breathe 5.5s ease-in-out infinite alternate;
+      transform-box: fill-box;
+      transform-origin: center;
+    }
+
+    .warm-reflection {
+      animation: reflection-breathe 6.5s ease-in-out infinite alternate;
+      transform-box: fill-box;
+      transform-origin: center;
+    }
+
+    .steam {
+      transform: translate(var(--steam-x), var(--steam-y)) skewX(var(--steam-skew));
+      transform-origin: 50% 100%;
+      transition: transform 120ms linear;
+    }
+
+    .wisp {
+      opacity: 0;
+      animation: steam-rise 5.6s ease-in-out infinite;
+      transform-box: fill-box;
+      transform-origin: center bottom;
+    }

+    .wisp:nth-child(2) {

+      animation-duration: 6.4s;
+      animation-delay: -2.7s;
+    }

+      opacity: .22;

+

+      opacity: .48;

+      transform-box: fill-box;
+      transform-origin: center bottom;

+      transform-box: fill-box;

+
